sections.Profile:
The Superman pinball machine, released by Atari in March 1979, was designed by Steve Ritchie with artwork by George Opperman. It was based on the popular DC Comics superhero and became one of Atari's most successful pinball machines, with 5,124 units produced.

- Years made: 1979
